chunks: Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"The prayer of the two Eids is obligatory, and the eclipse prayer is obligatory."

key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eids, meaning Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.الْكُسُوفِ: the eclipse, referring to the eclipse prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the ritual devotional prayer being discussed
key_terms.فَرِيضَةٌ: an obligatory duty established as binding

ai.seo_question: Are the Eid prayers and the eclipse prayer obligatory in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the prayers of the two Eids and the eclipse prayer are fard, meaning obligatory. It reflects the legal significance of these special prayers within Shia fiqh and indicates that they are not merely recommended acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1453 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"The prayers of the two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha) are obligatory, and the prayer of the eclipse (Salat al-Kusoof) is also obligatory."
